thread:
incident-bot: PAGED: KV cache fragmentation alert on us-west-dedicated-2 (severity: P1). metric kv_cache_fragmentation_pct > 85% for 5m, eviction failures and OOM retries observed. Automatic paging to on-call.

sara: on it. pulling telemetry now — what pods are most noisy?

jay: I see a few runtime nodes with continuous-batching spikes; sample: gpu-node-17 and gpu-node-19. fragmentation reports show slab_util ~ 0.92 and arena_free_ratio ~ 0.03.

neil: saw malloc failures in the pytorch allocator logs on gpu-node-19 around the same time. stack shows cudaMalloc returning OOM even though free memory exists but fragmented.

emily: customer-impact: a couple of requests for large seq lengths > 8k got 503s and re-routed to fallback models. telemetry shows 0.4% error spike across hosted customers between 13:12-13:18 UTC. sending heads-up to CS.

cs-bot: @cs-team customer-facing incident created: INC-2026-453. Impacted accounts: 3 mid-market customers. Notified account owners.

jay: trying safe mitigations: 1) enable kv_cache_compact=true for the two affected GPU pools to trigger compaction sweep 2) reduce continuous_batch_min to 1 for the pool to avoid large prefetched KV growth 3) schedule a rolling restart of the runtime pods with arena packing flags.

sara: agree. apply 1 and 2 now as non-disruptive flags. if that doesn't stabilize within 10m, we'll do a canary restart on gpu-node-17.

incident-bot: Action recorded: runbook kv-frag -> step 2 (compact flags). Notifying infra.

jay: pushing dynamic flag change:
```json
{"pool":"us-west-dedicated-2","kv_cache_compact":"true","continuous_batch_min":1}
```
Applied via infra-config-api (request id fc3a2b).

neil: watching malloc logs tail -f /var/log/runtime/pytorch_alloc.log on gpu-node-19:
```
[13:14:02] cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (error 2)
[13:14:03] arena chunk allocation failed: requested 512MB, largest_free 280MB
[13:14:05] kv_cache: compaction loop: freed 180MB
[13:14:07] eviction: failed to reclaim contiguous slab, fragmentation=0.91
```

emily: after applying compact=true, eviction success rate improved from 62% -> 87% within 3min, and error counts dropped. customers seeing successful fallbacks re-try.

sara: good. let's still prepare a targeted restart plan for node-19. canary set: runtime-pod-19a -> restart and monitor. if that resolves, we roll across the other affected nodes with 1 pod at a time.

jay: creating a minimal hotfix to arena tuning: set env ARENA_MAX_FREE_RATIO=0.25 and ARENA_SPLIT_THRESHOLD=8 for the runtime container. patch looks like:
```yaml
- name: runtime
  env:
    - name: ARENA_MAX_FREE_RATIO
      value: "0.25"
    - name: ARENA_SPLIT_THRESHOLD
      value: "8"
```
I'll apply to the canary pod only.

neil: note: these values are conservative; they reduce retention of free fragments and bias towards early compaction. should reduce failed contiguous allocs for large KV slices.

incident-bot: Canaried restart scheduled for runtime-pod-19a at 13:22 UTC by sara.

sara: performing canary restart now (kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime -n redwood-us-west --pod runtime-pod-19a).

jay: hotpatch env applied, pod restarted. logs show allocator warmup and compaction run: "arena: compacted 260MB, fragmentation -> 0.46"

neil: realloc attempts after restart succeed, sample log:
```
[13:23:14] cudaMalloc ok: allocated 512MB
[13:23:15] kv_cache: insert success seq=8092
[13:23:16] eviction: contiguous slab acquired
```

emily: telemetry: error rate back to baseline within 6m of canary restart. successful request throughput recovered. will keep monitoring for 30m before declaring mitigated.

sara: escalation notes: root likely a regression in pytorch allocator behavior with CUDA 12.3 + recent runtime change to continuous_batch prefetching that increased large-slice churn. we need a follow-up: reproduce with stress harness, add an integration test for fragmentation metrics, and evaluate permanently lowering continuous_batch max and enabling more aggressive arena compaction by default.

jay: filing follow-up issue: INF-9521 "reproduce arena fragmentation under high continuous_batch churn (CUDA 12.3)". tagging runtime and eng-ml.

neil: also pushing a telemetry alert tweak: alert threshold bumped from 85% -> 80% and add a second signal for eviction_failure_rate > 5% to catch earlier.

cs-bot: customer comms drafted and approved. Status: brief outage while workers rolled, automatic fallbacks preserved correctness. ETA to customers: postmortem within 48h.

sara: Marking this thread HANDOFF -> oncall night team at 13:40 UTC. leaving runbook actions and artifact links in the incident doc. If anything regresses, page back to P1.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated: fragmentation stabilized (kv_cache_fragmentation_pct < 50% cluster-wide). Incident status: MONITORING.

emily: quick notes for postmortem: timestamped metrics, the patch we applied (kv_cache_compact + arena env), the canary pod logs, and customer impact window (13:12-13:20 UTC).

sara: thanks all. tagging runtime oncall for tomorrow's deep-dive.

jay: one last thing — ops tip: add a small compaction cron for low-traffic windows to proactively defragment big pools. saved us this time. :rocket:
